cause: New standalone regression imported GL20 for constants. Windows local SDK included constants-only OpenGL JAR; declared CI native compiler SDK intentionally has no OpenGL binding. Javac stopped before executing the new test.
fix: Use five specification integer constants in the test, retaining every behavior assertion. Exact packaged regression now passes with the OpenGL JAR removed. No GL binding/context introduced into native SDK.
